global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with crisp menma and shredded cabbage. A white ceramic spoon rests in the center, all set against a dark, textured background under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Black textured table surface with subtle grain, oval shape, and slight sheen reflecting ambient light.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and bubbly, with visible noodles and toppings partially submerged.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous texture.
